resources.string: Turn on BT Voice Type as an input method in Android system settings.
Switch to BT Voice Type from the keyboard picker whenever you want to dictate.
Pair your Bluetooth headset/mic in Android Bluetooth settings first. BT Voice Type will route audio through it automatically when you tap the mic button.

Dictation uses a small speech-recognition engine built directly into this app (Vosk, English) — fully on-device, no internet and no Google app/services required at all. The first time you dictate, the app unpacks its speech model to storage, which takes a few seconds; after that it\'s instant.
Shows a small draggable mic button on top of every app. Tap it to dictate straight into whatever text field is focused, using your Bluetooth mic — no need to switch keyboards.
A small draggable mic bubble that stays on screen over any app — Gboard included — so you never have to switch keyboards to dictate. Needs two one-time permissions below.
Needed so the mic bubble can float on top of whatever app you\'re using.
Needed so the bubble can type recognized text into the field you\'re focused on, in any app. In the list, find \"BT Voice Type — Floating Mic\" and turn it on.
